summary: Full backend (21 pytest) and end-to-end frontend testing of NeoType Dojo. All 21 backend endpoints pass. All frontend flows (landing, register, login, dashboard, nav, lessons, quotes, boss-fight, leaderboard, achievements, typing-practice w/ session submission, profile, logout) verified via Playwright using data-testid selectors. No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout after repeated failures (playbook recommends lockout after 5 fails). Not implemented.
achievements_meta in response only contains newly unlocked achievements; field name slightly misleading but matches spec.

issues: After clicking navbar-logout, redirect goes to /login (not landing /). Original test spec expected return to landing page. Functionally fine but may be intentional/spec mismatch.

action_items: (Optional) Consider redirecting to / (landing) after logout instead of /login if matching spec strictly.
(Optional) Add brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login per playbook guidance.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORS has both allow_origins=['*'] and allow_credentials=True which is technically invalid per spec (browsers reject wildcard with credentials). However allow_origin_regex='.*' is also set which is what actually permits credentialed CORS. Works in practice but cleanup recommended (remove allow_origins=['*']).
server.py: ADMIN_PASSWORD has default 'admin123' baked in code (line 431). For production, require env-only without default to prevent fail-open.
server.py: evaluate_achievements uses ACHIEVEMENT_RULES with hardcoded streak_3 trigger when streak>=3, but only checks new streak after first session. Works as intended.
TypingPractice flow: uses window keydown listener (works) but won't be focus-trapped to typing area; any keystroke on the page triggers it. Acceptable for dojo UX.
Auth cookie samesite=none + secure=true correctly set for cross-origin scenarios. httpOnly verified.
test_credentials: admin@neotype.dojo / admin123 (seeded); fresh users registered via UI for testing.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ prefixed users registered during tests (e.g. test_<timestamp>@neotype.dojo, uitest_<timestamp>@neotype.dojo). Admin seeded automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py covers all endpoints. Auth is cookie-based (httpOnly) but backend also accepts Authorization: Bearer header for testing convenience. For Playwright typing flow, use page.keyboard.type(text) after clicking [data-testid=typing-input-area]. All pages have proper data-testid attributes. Frontend external URL is https://anime-type-learn.preview.emergentagent.com.
